error.component_not_ready:
{command} failed: {component} is not initialized.
Please run /anam status to check plugin status; if abnormal, check startup logs.

status: Confirm memory engine initialization is complete
Check logs for exception stack trace to locate specific module
search: Confirm keyword is not empty and of reasonable length
Confirm database and index files exist and are readable/writable
Check logs for retrieval component initialization failure
forget: Confirm memory ID exists and belongs to currently accessible data
Confirm database is not occupied by another process for a long time
Check logs for delete call stack
rebuild_index: Confirm database and index files are readable/writable
Locate failed documents from logs and retry rebuild
rebuild_graph: Confirm graph memory feature is enabled
Confirm database and index files are readable/writable
Check logs to locate specific failed documents
summarize: Confirm current session has at least 2 unsummarized messages
Check logs for summary processing stack trace
reset: Confirm session ID is valid and session storage is accessible
Check logs for clear_session call stack
cleanup: Confirm current session has readable historical records
Check logs for cleanup call stack
migrate: Confirm the legacy data directory still exists under data/plugin_data (default name astrbot_plugin_livingmemory)
Confirm free disk space exceeds 1.15x the legacy data size
migrate_verify: Confirm the legacy data directory has not been deleted or moved
If the legacy database is locked by another process, disable the old plugin first
vacuum: Confirm free disk space is at least the size of the main database (VACUUM needs equivalent temporary space)
Avoid running it at the same time as the daily decay job
identity: Run the command from the platform you want to diagnose so the real Bot account can be read
If the conversation manager is reported as not ready, run /anam status first
Check the log for entries prefixed with [IdentityRepair]
fix_identity: Run /anam fix-identity first and confirm the detected Bot account
Run it from the affected platform to avoid falling back to statistical inference
If the outcome looks wrong, run /anam fix-identity rollback to restore

webui.guide:
Anamnesis Management Interface

Please access via AstrBot official WebUI:
• Open AstrBot Dashboard
• Go to Plugins -> Anamnesis -> Pages -> dashboard

Tips:
• Plugin page reuses AstrBot login state, no extra login needed
• Requires AstrBot >= 4.24.2

Available in interface:
• Memory editing and management
• Visual statistics and analysis
• Graph browsing and recall debugging
• Data migration and index maintenance

migrate.next_steps:
Next steps:
1. /anam migrate-verify - reconcile the old and new data table by table
2. Restart AstrBot once verification passes so the plugin loads the migrated data
3. After recall works, uninstall the old plugin and delete its data directory
migrate.engine_busy:
The memory engine currently holds the database. Overwriting the database file at runtime would corrupt it, so the request was rejected.

Use the safe procedure instead:
1. Stop AstrBot
2. Delete anamnesis.db* / anamnesis.index / anamnesis_graph* from this plugin's data directory
3. Make sure migration_settings.auto_import_legacy is enabled
4. Restart AstrBot - the import runs before the database is opened
5. Run /anam migrate-verify after the restart

help.text:
Anamnesis User Guide

Core commands:
/anam status              View system status
/anam search <keyword> [count]  Search memories (default 5)
/anam forget <ID>          Delete specified memory
/anam rebuild-index       Rebuild index (fix inconsistency)
/anam rebuild-graph       Rebuild graph memory index (backfill old data)
/anam webui               Show WebUI management interface entry
/anam summarize [message_count]  Summarize now or re-summarize the latest messages
/anam reset               Reset current session memory context
/anam cleanup [preview|exec] Clean up memory injection fragments in historical messages (default preview)
/anam migrate [preview|exec] Import data from legacy LivingMemory (default preview)
/anam migrate-verify      Reconcile legacy and new databases before removing the old plugin
/anam vacuum              Prune write-operation logs and reclaim database disk space
/anam identity            Inspect name anchoring and bot-attribution diagnostics
/anam fix-identity [preview|exec|rollback] Repair bot messages recorded as group members (default preview)
/anam help                Show this help

Usage tips:
• Use search command for daily queries
• For complex management, go to Plugins -> Anamnesis -> Pages -> dashboard in AstrBot Dashboard
• Memories are automatically saved from conversations
• Use forget to delete sensitive information
• Execute rebuild-index when index is inconsistent
• After enabling graph memory, execute rebuild-graph to backfill old data
• After plugin update, execute cleanup to clean old data
• When migrating from LivingMemory, run migrate preview first to inspect the plan
• Run vacuum when the database grows large
• If bot messages look attributed to group members, run identity, then fix-identity

cleanup command examples:
  /anam cleanup          # Preview mode, shows statistics only
  /anam cleanup preview  # Same as above
  /anam cleanup exec     # Perform actual cleanup

migrate command examples:
  /anam migrate          # Preview only, shows the plan
  /anam migrate exec     # Perform the migration
  /anam migrate-verify   # Reconcile after migration

identity repair examples:
  /anam identity                    # Show anchor/guard/alias stats and attribution
  /anam fix-identity                # Preview only, shows how many rows would change
  /anam fix-identity exec           # Perform the repair (original values are backed up)
  /anam fix-identity exec aiocqhttp # Repair a single platform only
  /anam fix-identity rollback       # Roll back the previous repair

More info: https://github.com/Whereis-Alice/astrbot_plugin_anamnesis
